description: This is the main entry point for a React-based frontend application. It imports React, ReactDOM, CSS styles, and the main App component, then renders the App component into the DOM element with id 'root' using ReactDOM.createRoot, establishing the root rendering context.

methods.name: createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root to enable concurrent rendering and manage the React component tree.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the specified DOM container.
